# Jade CLI 0.4.2

- Build exported and imported packages from LF or CRLF section files without losing their definitions. Original source files remain unchanged.
- Keep every application, exported-package association and form when combining compact DDX files, including adjacent XML definitions.
- Refresh the RootSchema cache to capture native subclass lifetime permissions alongside the existing class permissions. Older caches continue to work; permissions absent from an older cache remain unknown.

Download `jade-cli-win-x64.zip` and keep its native helpers beside `jade-cli.exe`. A compatible licensed Jade runtime is required.
